conviction_note: The 27 Nov event is real but it is the delayed, final Half-Year Financial Report for H1 2026: H1 revenue and adjusted EBITDA were pre-released on 30 Sep, 9M on 30 Oct, and the FY2026 guide was reiterated on 30 Oct. So this is a pre-released period with a guide not expected to move: abs_move 3.5 (the European 3% base, nudged up for a 33-42% realised-vol restructuring name whose H1 cash flow, net debt, net result and financing note are still unseen) and p_up 49, a near-coin. The findings sum to -0.3 on one small lean (the FY margin guide needs a ~20% Q4 margin against 17.1% in Q3) and the scaled number is -0.07. Both are near zero for the same reason, so the gap between them carries no information.

already_public.what: Preliminary H1 2026 (the period this report covers): revenue EUR 1.10bn, adj. EBITDA EUR 168m (15.3%); Q2 revenue EUR 578m, adj. EBITDA EUR 102m. The release said the final half-year report would follow at the end of November 2026.

Preliminary Q3/9M 2026: Q3 revenue EUR 605m, adj. EBITDA EUR 103m (17.1%); 9M revenue EUR 1.7bn, adj. EBITDA EUR 272m (15.9%). 'Stronger fourth quarter ... in line with its guidance'; PPP closing pulled forward to Q1 2027; final Q3 statement due December 2026

FY2026 guide cut by ad-hoc (before M&A and refinancing): revenue in the lower half of EUR 2.3-2.4bn, adj. EBITDA margin ~17-18%, FCF EUR -50m to -100m. Auditor's opinion on FY2025 unqualified but emphasises the Centor sale and the refinancing
Centor sale completed (Centor is about half of the ~EUR 1.5bn combined EV); proceeds go to debt reduction; a comprehensive refinancing is planned after the PPP closing
Precedent for this kind of catch-up report: the final Q1 2026 Quarterly Statement showed 'no substantial changes compared to the preliminary figures'

new_in_release.expect: Final H1 revenue and adj. EBITDA: expected flat to the 30 Sep preliminaries (the Q1 precedent showed no substantial change). Any restatement would be the surprise; no sign that one is coming.

H1 free cash flow, net debt at 30 June and net result/EPS (impairments, held-for-sale remeasurement) have not been published. Direction unknown; this is where an unscheduled move could come from (FY FCF guide is EUR -50m to -100m).
The outlook section must restate the FY2026 guide. Expected reiterated (it was reiterated 30 Oct, and a change would need an ad-hoc). Slight risk of 'low end' wording on the margin.
Financing and risk-report text: covenant status against the standstill's 4.75x net debt/adj. EBITDA year-end test, and the refinancing timetable. Unknown.
None expected at a half-year report.

findings.finding: The 27 Nov release is the delayed final H1 2026 report for a half whose revenue and adj. EBITDA were pre-released on 30 Sep. The last catch-up report (final Q1 statement, 30 Sep) carried 'no substantial changes' to its preliminaries, so the reported lines should carry nothing new.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The day the final Q1 statement was published (30 Sep) it shared a release with the Q2 preliminaries and the stock rose 5.5%, then fell 4.2% the next day, so the catch-up report's own effect cannot be isolated. The preliminary Q3 release on 30 Oct moved the stock +0.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the numbers have been public for eight weeks. It is filed so the ranking knows this print is mostly a restatement. If the market expected a restatement of the preliminaries, the stock would be trading at a visible discount on rising shorts, and the short register is flat at 2.86%.
findings.independence: The IR calendar lists the report as the 'Half-Year Financial Report' with the Q3 statement still to come in December: https://www.gerresheimer.com/en/investors/investors-and-analysts/financial-calendar

findings.finding: The reiterated FY2026 guide (revenue in the lower half of EUR 2.3-2.4bn, adj. EBITDA margin ~17-18%) needs Q4 adj. EBITDA of about EUR 119-128m at a ~20% margin, against EUR 103m at 17.1% in Q3 and 15.9% for 9M. The outlook section the half-year report must carry could soften the wording to the low end.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 29 Jun 2026 guide-cut ad-hoc came alongside the long-delayed FY2025 accounts. The stock rose 5.9% that day because the accounts were finally out, so the cut was not punished in isolation. The Q4 'in line with guidance' reiteration on 30 Oct moved it +0.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The arithmetic is mine, from public figures: at 9M revenue EUR 1,706m and adj. EBITDA EUR 272m (Q1 67 + Q2 102 + Q3 103), 17% of EUR 2.30-2.35bn requires EUR 391-400m. The company reiterated the guide on 30 Oct, and a formal change would need an ad-hoc under MAR. So this is only a wording risk inside the guided range. If the market priced a cut, consensus targets would sit below spot (Deutsche Bank target 28, Hold, against spot 30.22), and that partly holds.
findings.independence: The 9M figures come from a different document, the 30 Oct release: https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/gerresheimer-reports-revenue-growth-and-stable-adjusted-ebitda-in-the-third-quarter-of-2026/83afe414-de16-4ac0-866f-77738cf14655_en. Retail press frames Q4 as the test ('Jetzt muss das Schlussquartal liefern', 2026-11-06): https://www.finanztrends.de/news/gerresheimer-aktie-jetzt-muss-schlussquartal-liefern/

findings.finding: Under the standstill with its banks and Schuldschein lenders, Gerresheimer must bring net debt / adj. EBITDA down to 4.75x by the end of FY2026, from 4.95x on about EUR 2bn of net debt at end-2025. The half-year report's financing and risk section is the first regulated document since the Centor closing that must address this test.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Financing news has driven this stock more than earnings: +11% on the Centor/PPP sale ad-hoc of 29 Jul (Börsen-Zeitung), and a rally when lenders extended deadlines in the spring.
findings.original_quote: So muss das Verhältnis der Nettoschulden zum bereinigten operativen Ergebnis (Ebitda) bis zum Ende des Geschäftsjahres auf das 4,75-Fache zurückgeführt werden, wie eine Sprecherin auf Anfrage sagte. Eine entsprechende Stillhaltevereinbarung hatten die Düsseldorfer mit ihren Banken und Schuldschein-Gläubigern unterzeichnet. Zum Bilanzstichtag 2025 hatte sich der Leveragefaktor bei einer Nettoverschuldung von 2 Mrd. Euro auf 4,95 belaufen. [Translation: 'Net debt to adjusted EBITDA must be brought down to 4.75x by the end of the financial year, a spokeswoman said on request. The Düsseldorf company had signed a corresponding standstill agreement with its banks and Schuldschein lenders. At the 2025 balance-sheet date leverage was 4.95x on net debt of EUR 2bn.']
findings.why_not_priced: The covenant number appeared once, in a German paper's answer from a spokeswoman, and not in any English-language EQS release. It is sized 0 because the money answers the question: the Centor proceeds (about half of a ~EUR 1.5bn EV) go to debt reduction. On rough arithmetic that reaches about 4.75x even after the FY FCF burn, so the test looks reachable and the sign depends on text not yet seen. If the market feared a breach, the short register would be building and it is flat.

My findings are near zero with a faint negative from the guide arithmetic. That disagrees mildly with the lean and agrees with the recent tape, which gives no reason to move p_up off a coin.
language_note: Börsen-Zeitung (German) carried the standstill's year-end covenant target of 4.75x net debt/adj. EBITDA and the 4.95x / EUR 2bn end-2025 starting point, from a company spokeswoman. It is not in any English EQS release found.

lessons_applied: 'Financing is a question, not a verdict': the covenant finding went from -0.2 to 0.0, because the Centor proceeds answer what the money buys and the 4.75x test looks reachable

'A finding that lands inside what the company already guided goes toward 0': the guidance-arithmetic finding went from -0.4 to -0.3, since the guide was reiterated 30 Oct and a change would need an ad-hoc

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': confirmed finding 1 at 0.0 and kept abs_move on the pre-released base (~3%, +0.5 for name volatility and the unseen cash flow) instead of the 7% new-numbers base
'Cash can outweigh a guide' (Luceco): H1 FCF and net debt added to new_in_release as the unknown-sign line most able to move the stock; p_up moved from 48 to 49, nearer 50
